facts.why: The Wikipedia production section calls it the film's Pandora Theater, the condemned theater where Nick shows the Jack Slater films.

vibe.verdict: Pandora Theater with Hamlet's line, the magic ticket, Whiskers and Death in the footer, and a sundae named after Jack's phrase.
ideas: Swap "Times Square knishes" for "Hamlet's cigar chocolates" with the line "Big mistake".
Swap "Movie world pepperoni" note for "Benedict's glass eye olives".
Swap "Matinee ice cream sundae" for "Ice cream truck special, hold the explosion".
Swap the popcorn note for Danny putting out the fuse with his bucket.
iconic: Arnold as Hamlet, 'Big mistake' (now the signed note)
Jack's 'to cone a phrase' ice cream line (sundae name)
Death steps out of The Seventh Seal (wink)
Whiskers the cartoon cat (existing dish and wink)
The magic Houdini ticket (existing dish, prop, wink)
Benedict's smiley glass eye (stays on the wink list)
changed: Sundae renamed To cone a phrase sundae
